# zurngtest

The goal of zurngtest is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of zurngtest from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zurngtest")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(zurngtest)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`pract_raw()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurngtest/reference/pract_raw.md)
  [`pract_fun()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurngtest/reference/pract_raw.md)
  : Sources of bits for pract_test()
- [`pract_test()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurngtest/reference/pract_test.md)
  : Test a source of random bits with 'PractRand'
- [`zurngtest_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurngtest/reference/zurngtest_info.md)
  : Information about zurngtest
